section.content: The utility model discloses a biological gene detection probe, which belongs to the technical field of gene detection and comprises a hollow column, wherein one end of the hollow column is provided with a threaded hole, the hollow column is connected with a limit column through the threaded hole, one end of the limit column, which is far away from the hollow column, is fixedly provided with a probe body, one end of the probe body, which is positioned in the limit column, is fixedly provided with an inductor, a transmission device for processing and transmitting information in the inductor is arranged in the hollow column, the outer wall of the hollow column is in sliding sleeve connection with a support cylinder, one side of the support cylinder, which is far away from the limit column, is provided with a driving component for driving the hollow column to slide, the open end of the support cylinder is fixedly provided with a limit plate, the side wall of the limit plate is provided with a through hole matched with the probe body, and one side of the limit plate is provided with a sector gear. The utility model has the sealing protection effect on the probe, reduces the possibility of bacteria in the air to the probe infection, and is suitable for popularization.

本申请公开了一种生物基因检测探针，属于基因检测技术领域，包括中空柱，所述中空柱的一端设置有螺纹孔，所述中空柱通过螺纹孔螺纹连接有限位柱，所述限位柱远离中空柱的一端固定安装有探针本体，所述探针本体位于限位柱内的一端固定安装有感应器，所述中空柱内设置有用于处理和传送感应器内信息的传输装置，所述中空柱的外壁滑动套接有支撑筒，所述支撑筒远离限位柱的一侧设置有驱动中空柱滑动的驱动组件，所述支撑筒的开放端固定安装有限位板，所述限位板的侧壁设置有与探针本体相匹配的通孔，所述限位板的一侧安装有扇形齿轮。本实用新型具有对探针的密封防护作用，降低了空气中细菌对探针感染的可能性，适宜推广。

Biological gene detection probeTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to a biological gene detection probe.

Background

The thermophysical parameters of organisms are basic parameters of biological thermophysical research, and the accurate measurement of the parameters has important significance for modeling and checking calculation of biological heat mass transfer process, thermal response of biological tissues under the action of heat source, reconstruction of organism temperature field and the like, and has wide application background in clinical medicine in particular.

Chinese patent publication No.: (CN 217922112U) discloses a biological gene detection probe, including the probe shell, the inside swing joint of probe shell has the movable block, the bottom contact of movable block is connected with the installation piece, the inside fixedly connected with probe body of installation piece, the inside of probe shell is provided with telescopic machanism, telescopic machanism includes the motor with probe shell inner wall fixed connection, the output shaft fixedly connected with screw rod of motor, the outside threaded connection of screw rod has one end to run through and extend to the slide bar of fixed plate bottom. This application is through setting up telescopic machanism for under the effect of motor and screw rod, can stretch out and withdraw the probe body, can withdraw the probe body inside the probe shell after installing the probe body, thereby prevent that the probe body from being damaged by external force, through the motor, can play the help to probe body collection work.

For the above related art, there is a certain disadvantage, for example, after the probe body is used, the probe housing is retracted through the telescopic mechanism, and since the end of the housing close to the probe is open, the probe body is exposed to the air and is easily polluted by bacteria, so in order to solve such problems, we propose a biological gene detection probe.

Disclosure of Invention

In order to solve the problems, the utility model provides a biological gene detection probe, which adopts the following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a biological gene detection probe, includes the hollow post, the one end of hollow post is provided with the screw hole, the hollow post has spacing post through screw hole threaded connection, the one end fixed mounting that the hollow post was kept away from to the spacing post has the probe body, the one end fixed mounting that the probe body is located the spacing post has the inductor, be provided with the transmission device who is used for handling and conveys the information in the inductor in the hollow post, the outer wall slip of hollow post has cup jointed a support section of thick bamboo, the one side that the spacing post was kept away from to the support section of thick bamboo is provided with the gliding actuating assembly of drive hollow post, the open end fixed mounting of support section of thick bamboo has the limiting plate, the lateral wall of limiting plate is provided with the through-hole with probe body assorted, one side that the limiting plate is close to the spacing post is rotated through the pivot and is installed sector gear, the optical ring section fixed mounting of sector gear circumference lateral wall has the closing plate, the lateral wall of limiting plate is provided with the actuating mechanism that is used for adjusting the closing plate position.

Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, drive group price drive hollow column slides in the support section of thick bamboo, adjusts the detection height of probe body, and probe body cooperation transmission device detects biological gene to with data upload, accomplish the back that detects, drive assembly drives hollow column and probe body and reset, drive mechanism drive sector gear rotates, drives the closing plate and seals the through-hole on the limiting plate.

Further, the transmission device comprises a sensing device, the inner wall of the hollow column is fixedly provided with a partition plate, the hollow column is divided into two accommodating cavities through the partition plate, the sensing device is fixedly arranged in the accommodating cavities, close to the limiting column, in the hollow column, and the sensing device is electrically connected with the inductor.

By adopting the technical scheme, the probe body is matched with the transmission device to detect the biological genes and upload the data.

Further, the hollow column is far away from the accommodating cavity of the limit column, and a battery assembly is fixedly arranged in the accommodating cavity and electrically connected with the sensing device.

By adopting the technical scheme, the battery assembly has the functions of electricity storage and power supply.

Further, the drive assembly includes the base, base fixed mounting is kept away from one side of spacing post in supporting the section of thick bamboo, be provided with spacing chamber between the barrel head of base and supporting the section of thick bamboo, spacing intracavity fixed mounting between base and the supporting the section of thick bamboo has electric telescopic handle, the body of rod top of electric telescopic handle is articulated the setting with the one end lateral wall that spacing post was kept away from to the cavity post.

By adopting the technical scheme, the driving assembly drives the hollow column to slide in the supporting cylinder, so that the probe position adjusting function is realized.

Further, the sealing plate is matched with the through hole, and a rubber pad is arranged on one side, close to the limiting plate, of the sealing plate.

By adopting the technical scheme, the tightness of the through hole of the limiting plate is improved.

Further, the driving mechanism comprises a motor, the motor is fixedly arranged on one side, far away from the limiting post, of the limiting plate, an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the limiting plate and is rotationally connected with the limiting plate, a spur gear is fixedly arranged at the end part of the output shaft of the motor, and the spur gear is meshed with the sector gear.

By adopting the technical scheme, the motor drives the spur gear to be meshed with the sector gear for transmission, and the position of the limiting plate is adjusted.

In summary, the utility model has the following beneficial technical effects:

through the installation of hollow post and support section of thick bamboo, drive group price drive hollow post slides in support section of thick bamboo, adjusts the detection height of probe body to probe body cooperation transmission device detects biological gene to with data upload, accomplish the back that detects, drive assembly drives hollow post and probe body and reset, drive mechanism drive sector gear rotates, drives the closing plate and seals the through-hole on the limiting plate, has the sealed guard action to the probe, has reduced the possibility that bacteria in the air infects the probe.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of the structure of the present utility model;

FIG. 2 is a cross-sectional view of a spacing post of the present utility model;

FIG. 3 is a mounting block diagram of a spacing post of the present utility model;

fig. 4 is a mounting structure view of the sector gear of the present utility model.

The reference numerals in the figures illustrate:

1. a hollow column; 2. a limit column; 3. a probe body; 4. an inductor; 5. a partition plate; 6. a sensing device; 7. a battery assembly; 8. a support cylinder; 9. a base; 10. an electric telescopic rod; 11. a limiting plate; 12. a through hole; 13. a sector gear; 14. a sealing plate; 15. a motor; 16. spur gears.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present utility model will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present utility model; it is apparent that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present utility model, not all embodiments, and that all other embodiments obtained by persons of ordinary skill in the art without making creative efforts based on the embodiments in the present utility model are within the protection scope of the present utility model.

In the description of the present utility model, it should be noted that the positional or positional relationship indicated by the terms such as "upper", "lower", "inner", "outer", "top/bottom", etc. are based on the positional or positional relationship shown in the drawings, are merely for convenience of describing the present utility model and simplifying the description, and do not indicate or imply that the apparatus or elements referred to must have a specific orientation, be constructed and operated in a specific orientation, and thus should not be construed as limiting the present utility model. Furthermore, the terms "first," "second," and the like, are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance.

In the description of the present utility model, it should be noted that, unless explicitly specified and limited otherwise, the terms "mounted," "configured to," "engaged with," "connected to," and the like are to be construed broadly, and may be either fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected, for example; can be mechanically or electrically connected; can be directly connected or indirectly connected through an intermediate medium, and can be communication between two elements. The specific meaning of the above terms in the present utility model will be understood in specific cases by those of ordinary skill in the art.

The utility model is described in further detail below with reference to fig. 1-4.

Referring to fig. 1-3, a biological gene detection probe comprises a hollow column 1, wherein one end of the hollow column 1 is provided with a threaded hole, the hollow column 1 is connected with a limit column 2 through the threaded hole in a threaded manner, the limit column 2 has a supporting function, one end of the limit column 2 far away from the hollow column 1 is fixedly provided with a probe body 3, one end of the probe body 3 positioned in the limit column 2 is fixedly provided with an inductor 4, the inductor 4 is matched with the probe body 3 to carry out biological gene detection, the hollow column 1 is internally provided with a transmission device for processing and transmitting information in the inductor 4, the transmission device comprises a sensing device 6, the inner wall of the hollow column 1 is fixedly provided with a partition plate 5, the hollow column 1 is divided into two accommodating cavities through the partition plate 5, a space is reserved, the sensing device 6 is fixedly arranged in the accommodating cavity close to the limit column 2 in the hollow column 1, the sensing device 6 is electrically connected with the inductor 4, the sensing device 6 has the function of transmitting biological gene detection data, a battery assembly 7 is fixedly arranged in a containing cavity of the hollow column 1, which is far away from the limit column 2, the battery assembly 7 is electrically connected with the sensing device 6, has the functions of electric power storage and power supply, a supporting cylinder 8 is sleeved on the outer wall of the hollow column 1 in a sliding way, the supporting cylinder 8 has the function of supporting, a driving component for driving the hollow column 1 to slide is arranged on one side of the supporting cylinder 8, which is far away from the limit column 2, the driving component comprises a base 9, the base 9 is fixedly arranged on one side of the supporting cylinder 8, which is far away from the limit column 2, a limit cavity is arranged between the base 9 and the cylinder bottom of the supporting cylinder 8, a space is reserved, an electric telescopic rod 10 is fixedly arranged in the limit cavity between the base 9 and the supporting cylinder 8, the rod body top end of the electric telescopic rod 10 is hinged with one end side wall of the hollow column 1, which is far away from the limit column 2, has the function of driving the hollow column 1 to slide and has the function of adjusting the position of the probe.

Referring to fig. 1-2 and fig. 4, a limiting plate 11 is fixedly arranged at the open end of a supporting cylinder 8, a sealing effect on the supporting cylinder 8 is achieved, a through hole 12 matched with a probe body 3 is formed in the side wall of the limiting plate 11, a transmission space of the probe body 3 is reserved, a sector gear 13 is rotatably arranged on one side, close to a limiting post 2, of the limiting plate 11 through a rotating shaft, the transmission effect is achieved, a sealing plate 14 is fixedly arranged on an optical ring section of the circumferential side wall of the sector gear 13, the sealing plate 14 is matched with the through hole 12, the sealing effect on the through hole 12 is achieved, a rubber gasket is arranged on one side, close to the limiting plate 11, of the sealing plate 14, sealing performance is improved, a driving mechanism used for adjusting the position of the sealing plate 14 is arranged on the side wall of the limiting plate 11, the driving mechanism comprises a motor 15, the motor 15 is fixedly arranged on one side, away from the limiting post 2, of the limiting plate 11, an output shaft of the motor 15 is in penetrating and is rotatably connected with the limiting plate 11, a spur gear 16 is fixedly arranged at the end part of the output shaft of the motor 15, the spur gear 16 is meshed with the sector gear 13, the spur gear 16 is provided with the driving effect on the rotation of the sector gear 13, and the position of the sealing plate 14 is further adjusted.

The implementation principle of the embodiment of the utility model is as follows: firstly, a base 9 is fixed through a screw, then an electric telescopic rod 10 drives a hollow column 1 to slide in a supporting cylinder 8, the detection height of a probe body 3 is adjusted, the probe body 3, an inductor 4 and a sensing device 6 detect biological genes and upload data, after detection is completed, the electric telescopic rod 10 drives the hollow column 1 and the probe body 3 to reset, then a motor 15 drives a spur gear 16 and a sector gear 13 to engage and drive, a sealing plate 14 is driven to seal a through hole 12 on a limiting plate 11, and the sealing protection effect on the probe body 3 is achieved.

The above embodiments are not intended to limit the scope of the present utility model, so: all equivalent changes in structure, shape and principle of the utility model should be covered in the scope of protection of the utility model.
